question: Should OpenClaw commit to a top-level `auth` namespace containing this read-only shortcut while the remaining model-auth commands stay under `models auth`?
rationale: The delegation can be implemented safely, but repository evidence cannot determine whether a permanent partial parallel CLI namespace is desirable; that requires explicit product ownership.

options.title: Keep models auth canonical
options.body: Decline the root alias and retain one documented command family unless stronger user evidence supports a broader auth namespace.

options.title: Accept the narrow shortcut
options.body: Sponsor `openclaw auth list` as a permanent additive alias, then require live proof and green exact-head checks before merge.

options.title: Design a complete namespace
options.body: Pause this PR and define which model-auth operations should consistently appear under a top-level `auth` family.

recommendation.title: Keep models auth canonical
recommendation.body: Decline the root alias and retain one documented command family unless stronger user evidence supports a broader auth namespace.

likelyOwner.reason: They provide the strongest available merged-history signal for the current CLI ownership boundary between channels and model auth.
